system.description: Etch mystic sigils on the back of a circular mirror (4-18 inches) and bathe it in two of your own Blood Traits to permanently enchant it. The mirror's reflections reveal supernatural creatures' true natures (vampires as skeletal husks, werewolves in dual form, ghosts visible, etc.) for anyone visible to the naked eye, though it does not pierce Obfuscate or similar concealment.
